new_products.name: Kling Image 4.0 API
new_products.what_shipped: Kling Image 4.0 launched via new API endpoints (/image-generation/kling-4.0 for text-to-image/image-to-image and image sets, /long-image-generation/kling-4.0 for long-image generation), succeeding Kling Image 3.0. It adds native 8K resolution (up from 3.0's native 4K), improved realism/text rendering/instruction-following, and up to 10 combined image/subject references.
new_products.availability: Available now via Kling API; billing now counts both input reference images and output images (rate varies by resolution); long-image endpoint targets e-commerce/web design use cases.
new_products.practical_significance: Per Kling's own API changelog, this is a full major-version jump (3.0->4.0) in image generation resolution and reference handling, directly comparable to the already-tracked Kling 4.0 video generation line.
new_products.engineering_details: Supports 2K/4K/8K for single images and image sets (settings.series_amount 2-10 or auto), 1K/2K for long images, up to 50,000-character English prompts (21,000 for non-English), and task status via GET /tasks.
new_products.limitations: No specific pricing figures were given in the changelog itself (points to a separate pricing page); no independent third-party coverage was found confirming quality claims.
